Cluster University Srinagar was founded in 2016.

It offers education in its various colleges for the streams of Humanities, Commerce, Engineering, Education, Science,
Management
, and Liberal Arts.

Cluster University

is a state university that UGC approves.

Students who want to be admitted for the BA, BCA, and BSc will be based on the CUET 2026 and have the 12th-class certificate.

The Cluster University application form fee is Rs 700 for various courses.

Students who want to apply for the Undergraduate (UG) level programs should have completed 10+2 from the relevant board.

To get admission for the postgraduate (PG) level courses, students must have a bachelor's level degree with good marks.

Cluster University Admission 2026-27 Lates Updates

The entrance exam for CUET UG is going to be conducted from
15 May to 24 May 2026
by the National Test Agency in CBT and Pen Paper Mode

.

Cluster University Srinagar will soon start accepting applications for UG and PG courses admission, and the deadline will be set as
25 July 2026
.

Cluster University of Srinagar is starting the application process for its Post Graduate (PG) program. Students must pass the CUET PG entrance exam to get admission to this course. Students should fill out their application forms by the last date of

6 June 2026.

Cluster University offers various Undergraduate, Postgraduate, Diploma, and Certificate courses admission based on entrance exam scores. Cluster University Admission 2026 last date is
28 July 2026
. Students can find out the application form at
www.cusrinagar.edu.in.
So, candidates are advised to apply for Cluster University admission 2026-27 before the deadline.

It is a public university that offers courses in management, social science, arts, computing applications, engineering, education, and science.

Cluster University Srinagar PG Admission is done after passing the relevant entrance exam. The official website will provide the admission form. The infrastructure development is funded through the Rashtriya Uchchatar Shiksha Abhiyan (RUSA).
There are almost 31 courses offered at UG and PG levels. All courses are offered in regular and full-time mode; also, it offers
integrated
courses with different duration. The university conducts entrance exams like
GATE,
JEE Main
,
and
GPAT
.
For professional courses, a fee of Rs 1685 must be paid.

CU Srinagar UG Admission 2026-27

CU Srinagar UG Admission 2026-27 provides many courses in the fields of science, education, commerce, arts, Medical and non-medical etc. There are around
250
seats in each UG course. The admissions to these courses are based on entrance tests like CUET UG, JEE and others. CU Srinagar Admission to some courses is on a merit basis. The application form for interested students to apply will be released on the official website. For session 2026-27, CU Srinagar UG Admission's last date is
28 July 2026
.

At the Undergraduate level, the university offers admission to various courses like BA, Bcom, BSc, BCA, BBA, BTech, BHM, BVoc and others. Cluster University UG admissions are majorly done through the CUET UG except for BTech. For Btech admission, the university considers JEE mains scores.

Cluster University BTech Admission 2026-27

Cluster University BTech Admission 2026-27 last date is
30 April 2026.
In the institution, campus admission to disciplines like computer engineering, mechanical engineering, biomedical engineering, etc. In the process for Cluster University Srinagar admission to the BTech course, the institution will be considering the ranking of the applicants in the entrance exam that the institution will be conducting on its campus. Before applying for admission, the applicant must have completed their 12th class from a recognized institution.

Students who are willing to get admission to B Tech courses offered by Cluster University will have to qualify for the
JEE Main
entrance exam. And must secure the minimum passing marks to be able to qualify in the exam.

Cluster University Application Form 2026-27

Click on "Register here" under the "New User" option to visit the official cluster university Srinagar admission portal of the university. Once it has been submitted, applicants cannot edit the application form. Once the process of document verification has been completed for all applicants, a common merit list will be announced. Cluster University Srinagar Application Form 2026 submission last date is
28 July 2026
for the PG courses.

If you want to apply for Cluster University under any reserved category few things are necessary to do a Self-Attested photocopy of the Reserved Category Certificate along with a Hard-Copy of the
Cluster University Application Form 2026
and other necessary documents at CU Srinagar Office. White Background passport size photograph in formats like .jpg", ".bmp" , ".jpeg" or ".png" size between 20-70KB, for uploading in CU Application Form 2026.
Cluster University Srinagar Application Form fee
for Professional courses is Rs 500 and for Non professional courses is Rs 200.

Cluster University Srinagar Admission Procedure 2026-27

The candidate needs to visit the official website
http://www.cusrinagar.edu.in
.

Click on the link to the registration form.

Fill in all the details about you such as education, address proof, number, date of birth, etc.

Students have to upload their scanned photographs and signature.

After that click on the continue button.

No mistake while filling in the registration number, roll number, and date of birth.

The applicant has to pay the registration amount online mode.

When all process will complete applicant have to take the receipt.

Required Documents In Cluster University Srinagar Admission 2026-27

High School Mark-sheets and certificate

Intermediate Mark-sheets and certificate

Transfer Certificate

Category Certificate

Income Certificate

Admit Card/ Scorecard

Cluster University Srinagar Entrance Exam

Based on the results of the screening test, integrated cluster university Srinagar admission for 5 years, 3 years of honours, and BCA are made. In addition to the Common Aptitude Test, the Subject-Specific Test is included in the screening test. GATE, JEE Main, and GPAT are some of the access tests the University administers. The common suitability test (CAT) will be used for admissions to BA, BSc, B.Com, and BSc (home science).
